# Skill Bridgeway Foundation

> RJSC-registered non-profit in Bangladesh (head office: Bogura) offering free, practical, beginner-friendly training in AI literacy, digital skills, freelancing, digital marketing and entrepreneurship for rural youth, madrasah students and underserved communities.

Key facts:
- Flagship: a 75-day Practical AI & Digital Skills Program — 4 sequential courses in 2 segments, from absolute beginner to intermediate, project-based.
- Admission is free; apply online from a course page.
- Certificates carry unique serials and can be verified publicly at https://skillbridgeway.org/verify
- Chairman: Md Saiful Azam. Executive Director (Operations): Md. Ziaul Haque Manik.
- Contact: info@skillbridgeway.org · WhatsApp +880 1717-224952 · Offices in Bogura (Bangladesh) and London (UK).
